``` {r cor}
numeric_df <- og_kinship_result[sapply(og_kinship_result, is.numeric)]
cor(numeric_df, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")
pcor.test(og_kinship_result$Nonnormalized_P0_serr, og_kinship_result$KinshipCoefficient, og_kinship_result$OverlapNSNPs, method="spearman")

```

``` {r cor 2}
cor_check <- og_kinship_result |> mutate(Low_data = if_else(Low_data == "yes", 1, 0, missing = 0))
num_corcheck <- cor_check[sapply(cor_check, is.numeric)]
cor(num_corcheck, use = "pairwise.complete.obs", method = "spearman")[, "Low_data"]

```
